summary: Frontend-only testing of LC Gardeners marketing site. Verified page load, all required sections, data-testid attributes, tel:/mailto: links, anchor scrolling, reviews verified badges, responsive floating call button, content text correctness, and zero console errors. All 24+ flows from the review request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar outer <nav> element returns transparent background in getComputedStyle (rgba(0,0,0,0)) because the styling is applied to an inner wrapper div. Visually the nav is opaque/white as designed — purely a selector observation, not a bug. Consider applying the bg directly on <nav> for cleaner DOM semantics.

Reviews section has 6 stars worth of SVGs per card (5 stars + 1 trailing icon: Verified badge for real reviewers, quote icon for generic). Acceptable, but worth noting if review-card star-count assertions are added in regression suites.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure static marketing site at https://reliable-landscapes.preview.emergentagent.com. No backend or forms. All CTAs are tel:+13605134172 or mailto:Hoango1965@yahoo.com. All 25 required data-testids verified present. Floating call button uses md:hidden (desktop hidden, mobile <768 visible). Reviews 0-2 are real (with Verified badge), 3-5 generic.
